Class RagGenerationConfig

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.rag.schema.RagGenerationConfig
public class RagGenerationConfig extends Object
Strongly-typed DTO for RAG generation (LLM) configuration. Mirrors the fields in tech.kayys.wayang.rag.core.GenerationConfig.
